title: Spatial capture-recapture of leopard from 85 paired camera stations in Tswalu Kalahari Reserve, South Africa: 5 individuals, 127 daily occasions, January-May 2024
creator: Visagie, Marna; Davis, Robert Simon; Overton, Elizabeth Kennedy; Venter, Jan
citation: Visagie, M., Davis, R. S., Overton, E. K., & Venter, J. (2026). Data and code from: Estimating large carnivore populations in an arid fenced reserve using spatial capture-recapture modelling [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.rxwdbrvrt
abstract: Daily detections of individually identified leopard (Panthera pardus) at 85 paired camera-trap stations in the Korannaberg section of Tswalu Kalahari Reserve, Northern Cape, South Africa, 18 January to 23 May 2024, as the authors' oSCR input: one row per individual x station x day the station operated, with station placement (on trail or not) and distance to the spotted hyaena den.
samplingProtocol: 85 paired camera-trap stations operated over 127 daily occasions; individuals identified from natural markings; detections per individual, station and day (proximity detectors), with a per-day operation matrix.
surveyEvidenceNote: The deposited operation matrix (station x day) defines the survey set: a station-day is surveyed iff marked 1 (9,978). Four station-days marked 0 carry a photograph (spotted hyaena at station 16 on days 115 and 122; brown hyaena at station 78 on days 86 and 98); the photographs are believed and the four are added as surveyed in all three species' tables (9,982).
closureNote: one 127-day session analysed as a closed population (oSCR)
crs: local: station positions centred on the array centroid by the processor, metres (source: 1 km grid centroids, WGS 84 / UTM 34S)
geographicCoverage: Korannaberg section of Tswalu Kalahari Reserve, Northern Cape, South Africa; array centroid about 27.3 S, 22.4 E

coordinatesCoarsened.method: station coordinates (generalised by the source to 1 km grid centroids) centred on the array centroid by the processor, local metres, UTM positions withheld, because leopard (IUCN VU) shares the camera array with the two hyaena tables; the centroid is given at 0.1 degree in geographicCoverage

designNote: Experimental list of E9: spatial capture-recapture with a trap key and __traps; daily Bernoulli detections at proximity detectors.

notShipped.model_outputs: fitted oSCR models, state-space grid, predicted density rasters and shapefiles (not observations)
notShipped.duplicate_rows: duplicate detection rows in the encounter files, removed as in the authors' script
notShipped.utm_coordinates: station UTM coordinates (1 km centroids), withheld under E7 (centred instead)

notes: One of three species tables from one camera array (leopard, brown hyaena, spotted hyaena). 5 individuals; ids as deposited. date = 2024-01-17 + occasion (127 days, 18 January to 23 May 2024, as the README states).
